title: satk.util.ad~
description: `satk.util.ad~` generates a three-segment attack/sustain/decay envelope with both signal-rate and data-rate outputs, suitable for contouring oscillator amplitude or controlling other parameters. A gate value greater than 0 starts the attack to the sustain level, while 0 starts the decay to 0; alternatively, a bang runs a fixed-duration envelope set by the duration parameter.
